Ledger Core: architecture and capabilities
Synthetic demonstration data. Owner: Finance Applications. Version 1.0.
Ledger Core is a Java monolith that posts and reconciles financial transactions.
HAS_CAPABILITY: transaction posting
HAS_CAPABILITY: reconciliation
HAS_CAPABILITY: audit export
DEPENDS_ON: Identity Gateway
DEPENDS_ON: Enterprise Event Bus
DEPENDS_ON: Archive Store
Identity Gateway provides user authentication. Enterprise Event Bus carries posting events. Archive Store retains exported audit files.

Migration scope
Preserve transaction identifiers, reconciliation totals, and audit history. Data migration and rollback design have not been approved. No shutdown date has been agreed.
